title: Miltiades the Archon
summary: Raleigh names Miltiades the Archon in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Miltiades, named among the annuall Magistrates of Athens before Draco and Solon. He is not the Miltiades of the Scythian bridge and of Marathon. The one-word title would fold onto that Miltiades, so the title is three words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
